title: Momentum / engagement trajectory

questions.text: Is the account getting stronger, weaker, or simply noisier?

criteria.text: the account's trajectory from the activity graph
criteria.guide: Classify the trajectory from the sequence of activities, not a static snapshot.
A cooling account calls for light re-engagement, not an escalated ask; a heating one for a concrete step.

principles: Use the HAR-96 activity graph rather than a static snapshot.
The same inbound email can imply something very different depending on the trajectory that preceded it.

labels.label: STABLE
labels.when: Engagement is steady; nothing has cooled or accelerated.

labels.label: COOLING
labels.when: Replies slow, silence, or commitments slip.

labels.label: REACTIVATED
labels.when: The account re-engages after a quiet period.

labels.label: NOISY_WITHOUT_PROGRESS
labels.when: Activity without movement in stage, commitments or depth.

diagnostics.name: engagement_cooling
diagnostics.when: the trajectory is cooling and the action does not account for it
